Set the groups

Source: R/generics.R, R/screenr-class.R
set_groups.Rd

Replaces the experimental groups of the samples of a ScreenR object. A warning is given when the number of groups differs from the number of samples.

Usage

set_groups(object, groups)

# S4 method for class 'screenr_object'
set_groups(object, groups)

Arguments

object

The ScreenR object obtained using create_screenr_object.

groups

A factor (or a vector, which is converted to a factor) with the group of each sample, for example "Control" and "Treated".

Value

The ScreenR object with the new groups.

See also

get_groups, create_design_matrix

Examples

object <- get0("object", envir = asNamespace("ScreenR"))
groups <- get_groups(object)
set_groups(object, groups)
